reason: Every notice already lands in my class WhatsApp groups, usually with someone summarising it for me. I might install it if the college pushes it, but a month later I'd still be checking WhatsApp, not another app.
objection: I already get everything on WhatsApp groups, so this is just one more app sending me the same notices a bit later.
would_change_my_mind: If professors and admin stopped posting in WhatsApp groups and UniDash became the only place exam notices and deadline changes showed up first.
